details.question: PayNow 转账要收钱吗？
details.rewritten: PayNow 转账要收钱吗？
details.hyde: PayNow 本地新元转账一般免手续费；海外电汇或多币种账户跨境转账可能另收费用，以交易页显示为准。

details.question: What's the charge for sending a TT to Malaysia?
details.rewritten: What's the charge for sending a TT to Malaysia?
details.hyde: Malaysia TT: overseas remittance fee + cable/correspondent charges; fees vary.

details.question: 你们的 exchange rate 是怎么定的？周末会不会不一样？
details.rewritten: 你们的 exchange rate 是怎么定的？周末会不会不一样？
details.hyde: 本行汇率按市场汇率加银行点差制定，工作时间内随市场更新；周末及公共假期一般沿用最近报价，可能不实时变动。海外电汇、PayNow及多币种账户交易，以确认页汇率为准。
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: I paid in USD on Amazon with my Visa, why was there an extra 3.25%?
expected: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用
details.rewritten: I paid in USD on Amazon with my Visa, why was there an extra 3.25%?
details.hyde: The extra 3.25% is a foreign transaction/cross-currency fee. Your USD Visa transaction was converted to your card’s billing currency, so the fee applies. It will appear on your statement.
kept: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: 在日本 ATM 拿钱要多少 fee？
details.rewritten: 在日本 ATM 拿钱要多少 fee？
details.hyde: 在日本ATM取现，费用视卡种及账户而定，一般含本行海外取现手续费、日本ATM运营商附加费及汇率差价；多币种账户可扣对应币种，交易以PIN及OTP验证为准。

details.question: statement 上面有一笔看不懂的小额 charge 是什么？
details.rewritten: statement 上面有一笔看不懂的小额 charge 是什么？
details.hyde: 请核对交易描述与日期；小额扣款可能是海外电汇/跨境交易手续费、多币种账户兑换费，或商户预授权/PayNow/FAST/GIRO相关费用。若非您授权，请立即冻结卡并联系银行。

details.question: 信用卡年费可以免吗？
expected: 银行卡年费与其他卡费
details.rewritten: 信用卡年费可以免吗？
details.hyde: 可以。多数信用卡可通过年度消费达标、绑定 GIRO 自动扣缴或积分抵扣免年费；未达标可致电客服申请豁免，以本行审核为准。
kept: 银行卡年费与其他卡费
top_reranked: 银行卡年费与其他卡费

details.question: What's the difference between PayNow and FAST?
details.rewritten: What's the difference between PayNow and FAST?
details.hyde: PayNow uses your mobile number/NRIC/UEN for instant SGD transfers to participating banks. FAST uses the recipient’s bank account number for instant SGD interbank transfers. Both are domestic real-time services, not overseas telegraphic transfers or GIRO.

details.question: FAST transfer 一般几分钟会到？
details.rewritten: FAST transfer 一般几分钟会到？
details.hyde: FAST 转账一般即时到账，通常几分钟内完成；实际到账时间视收款银行处理及系统状态而定。

details.question: How do I send money to my mum's bank account in China?
details.rewritten: How do I send money to my mum's bank account in China?
details.hyde: Use Overseas Wire Transfer in online banking. Add your mum’s China bank account as payee, select CNY/multi-currency account, enter amount, confirm with PIN/OTP. PayNow/FAST/GIRO don’t apply.

details.question: 我朋友在美国要汇钱给我，要给他什么资料？
details.rewritten: 我朋友在美国要汇钱给我，要给他什么资料？
details.hyde: 请将收款人姓名、账号、开户行名称及SWIFT/BIC提供给朋友；如使用多币种账户，请确认币种及账号。美国汇入一般走海外电汇。

details.question: Why can't I add Binance as a payee?
details.rewritten: Why can't I add Binance as a payee?
details.hyde: Binance cannot be added as a payee because cryptocurrency exchange transactions are not supported under our current policy. For eligible transfers, please use overseas wire transfer, PayNow, FAST or GIRO; payee setup requires PIN/OTP verification.

details.question: 我想一次转 SGD 10,000 给朋友，可以吗？
details.rewritten: 我想一次转 SGD 10,000 给朋友，可以吗？
details.hyde: 可以，但须符合渠道及每日限额。PayNow/FAST 限额不足 SGD 10,000 时，请先以 PIN/OTP 调整；海外电汇需收款资料，多币种账户可直接扣账。

details.question: My transfer got returned, what usually causes that?
details.rewritten: My transfer got returned, what usually causes that?
details.hyde: Transfers are usually returned because of incorrect beneficiary name/account number, closed/inactive account, name mismatch, transaction limits, or failed PIN/OTP verification. For overseas wires, invalid SWIFT/intermediary details can also trigger a return; for PayNow/FAST/GIRO, bank or account restrictions may apply. For multi-currency accounts, check currency/account restrictions. Please quote the return reason and reference number when contacting us.

details.question: 新卡收到了要怎么开通？
details.rewritten: 新卡收到了要怎么开通？
details.hyde: 登录网上银行/手机银行，在“卡片管理”激活新卡，设置PIN并完成OTP验证。激活后可用PayNow、FAST、GIRO及多币种账户；海外电汇需另行开通。

details.question: My new card still hasn't arrived after two weeks
details.rewritten: My new card still hasn't arrived after two weeks
details.hyde: Please check your card delivery status in the mobile app. If it has not arrived after 14 business days, call our hotline to request a replacement card and confirm your mailing address. Do not share your PIN or OTP with anyone. For urgent payments, you may use PayNow, FAST, GIRO or your multi-currency account via the app.

details.question: 我的 PIN 输错三次了，现在用不了
expected: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
details.rewritten: 我的 PIN 输错三次了，现在用不了
details.hyde: PIN连续输错三次会被锁定。请通过手机银行使用OTP验证重置PIN，或携卡及身份证件到ATM/网点解锁重置；解锁前无法使用该卡。
kept: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
top_reranked: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁

details.question: Why does my card keep getting declined overseas?
details.rewritten: Why does my card keep getting declined overseas?
details.hyde: It may be because overseas card use is disabled, your transaction limit is exceeded, your multi-currency account balance is insufficient, or PIN/OTP verification failed. Enable overseas transactions/travel notice in mobile banking, check limits and balances, and ensure you can receive OTPs.

details.question: ATM 把我的卡吃掉了
details.rewritten: ATM 把我的卡吃掉了
details.hyde: 请立即致电本行客服冻结该卡，切勿透露PIN或OTP；携带有效证件到ATM所属网点办理取卡或补卡。急用款可先用PayNow/FAST转账。

details.question: My card expires next month, do I need to apply for a new one?
details.rewritten: My card expires next month, do I need to apply for a new one?
details.hyde: No, you don’t need to apply. A replacement card will be mailed automatically before expiry. Activate it via OTP and set your PIN.

details.question: 可以给我太太办一张 supplementary card 吗？
details.rewritten: 可以给我太太办一张 supplementary card 吗？
details.hyde: 可以。请由主卡人提交配偶附属卡申请，附上太太身份证明及关系证明；经审批后发卡，额度与主卡共享，OTP发送至主卡人预留手机。

details.question: Is your debit card Visa or Mastercard?
details.rewritten: Is your debit card Visa or Mastercard?
details.hyde: Our debit cards are issued as either Visa or Mastercard, depending on the card type. Please check the card face or contact us to confirm your card network.
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: Can I open an account if I'm 15?
details.rewritten: Can I open an account if I'm 15?
details.hyde: No. At 15, you cannot open a standard account alone. You may open a youth/guardian-linked account with a parent or guardian present and required ID. PayNow/FAST/GIRO and online access may be limited; PIN/OTP rules apply.

details.question: 开户需要什么证件？没有 Singpass 可以吗？
details.rewritten: 开户需要什么证件？没有 Singpass 可以吗？
details.hyde: 开户请携带有效身份证/护照、准证及地址证明。无 Singpass 可到分行办理，需额外身份核验并设置 PIN/OTP；多币种账户及 PayNow、FAST、GIRO 可后续开通。

details.question: The app keeps rejecting my selfie during verification
details.rewritten: The app keeps rejecting my selfie during verification
details.hyde: Please retry in a well-lit area, remove glasses/hats, keep your full face within the frame, and allow camera access. Update the app and restart your phone. If rejected again, contact support. Never share your PIN or OTP.

details.question: 我搬家了，地址要怎么改？
details.rewritten: 我搬家了，地址要怎么改？
details.hyde: 请登录手机银行，在“个人资料”更新通讯地址；证件地址变更请携身份证件到分行办理。更新不影响多币种账户、PayNow、FAST、GIRO及海外电汇，需OTP验证。

details.question: I can't remember my internet banking password
details.rewritten: I can't remember my internet banking password
details.hyde: Use the “Forgot Password” link on our internet banking login page. Verify with an OTP sent to your registered mobile number, then set a new password. If you cannot receive the OTP or your account is locked, contact our hotline or visit a branch with your ID.

details.question: 我想 close 我的 savings account
details.rewritten: 我想 close 我的 savings account
details.hyde: 请先转出余额，取消GIRO、PayNow/FAST绑定，确认无未结交易及待入账海外电汇；多币种账户请结清各币种。可携证件到分行或经网银申请，需OTP验证；关闭后卡及PIN失效。

details.question: Can I hold Japanese yen in my account?
expected: 多币种账户支持的货币
details.rewritten: Can I hold Japanese yen in my account?
details.hyde: Yes. With a multi-currency account, you can hold Japanese yen and send/receive funds via overseas remittance. Local PayNow/FAST/GIRO transfers apply only to supported currencies; check eligibility.
top_reranked: 多币种账户支持的货币

details.question: 你们可以存比特币吗？
expected: 多币种账户支持的货币
details.rewritten: 你们可以存比特币吗？
details.hyde: 暂不支持比特币存款或交易。本行仅接受法定货币入金，可通过海外电汇、PayNow、FAST、GIRO存入多币种账户；请勿泄露PIN/OTP。
kept: 多币种账户支持的货币
top_reranked: 多币种账户支持的货币

details.question: 定期存款利率是多少？
details.rewritten: 定期存款利率是多少？
details.hyde: 定期存款利率随币种、存期及金额浮动，请以本行官网/手机银行实时公布为准；您也可登录网银或莅临网点查询最新优惠利率。
top_reranked: 银行卡年费与其他卡费

details.question: How do I apply for a home loan?
details.rewritten: How do I apply for a home loan?
details.hyde: Apply online or at any branch. Prepare your ID, income proof and property details. Submit the form and verify with OTP; a mortgage specialist will follow up. If approved, set up GIRO for monthly repayments.

details.question: 你们的分行几点开门？
details.rewritten: 你们的分行几点开门？
details.hyde: 各分行柜台时间不同，通常周一至周五9:00–16:30，周六部分营业；节假日以公告为准。海外电汇/GIRO请留意截止时间，PayNow/FAST等24小时可用，最新时间查官网/App。

details.question: Does my credit card come with travel insurance?
details.rewritten: Does my credit card come with travel insurance?
details.hyde: Travel insurance is included on selected credit cards only. Please refer to your card’s Benefits Guide for coverage, limits and exclusions. Claims may require OTP verification.

details.question: 那 FAST 呢？
details.rewritten: FAST 手续费是多少？
details.hyde: FAST 转账通常免手续费，实际费用以交易确认页显示为准。

details.question: what if I forgot the PIN?
expected: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
details.rewritten: What if I forgot the PIN for my new card?
details.hyde: Reset your new card’s PIN via the bank app or online banking using OTP. If unable, visit any branch with your ID. Never share your PIN or OTP with anyone.
kept: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
top_reranked: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
